Chapter 877: Chapter 16: The Perplexed Human Supreme (Please Subscribe)_2

Although those Twelve-Star ultimate existences didn’t directly intervene in the battlefield, their contingencies left in the Clan Suppression Weapons were activated, which is an indirect interference.

“So be it.”

“Only a little over twenty escaped.”

Lin Yuan turned his attention back to the remaining strongest Eleventh Level entities.

Not every strongest Eleventh Level entity carried a Clan Suppression Weapon, and those without one found it very difficult to tear open the spatial enclosure of the external world and were essentially unable to escape.

“The remaining Eleventh Levels will not withstand the sixth round of pressure from the external world, there’s no need to detonate ‘World’.”

Lin Yuan gave it a moment’s thought and made his decision.

If the strongest Eleventh Level from the Robber Clan was still present, for the sake of caution, Lin Yuan would detonate ‘World’.

But now?

With those strongest Eleventh Level entities having fled, there was no need to expose the full power of the Divine Ability ‘World’.

Whirring.

In an instant.

The sixth round of worldly suppression arrived.

The remaining strongest Eleventh Level entities from the various peak races had their physical bodies and souls shatter under the suppression, leaving behind many treasures floating in the air, which were ultimately collected by Lin Yuan.

Phew!!!

The fluctuations of the Divine Ability ‘World’ gradually dissipated.

After six seconds, only the Eleventh Level powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance remained on the once vast and expansive battlefield. As for the Eleventh Level powerhouses from other races? Almost all were dead, with only a few over twenty having escaped.

Lin Yuan was satisfied with this outcome; it was probably unprecedented in the long history since the cosmos was established for all the strongest Eleventh Level entities sent by the peak races to be annihilated.

Perhaps a major peak race once saw the fall of a large number of Eleventh Level avatars, but to include all the peak races, especially the Robber Clan, such an incident had never happened before.

…

“I’ve truly made a fortune this time…”

Lin Yuan briefly surveyed his inner world, where mighty weapons lay strewn carelessly in corners, alongside many other Twelve-Star rare treasures and contingencies left by Twelve-Star levels.

From the journey in the Two-dimensional World, Lin Yuan emerged as the ultimate victor, aside from the oddities returned to the Human Civilization, he collected nearly a hundred treasures.

Of these, roughly over thirty could be considered mighty weapons.

But now? The number of mighty weapons stored in Lin Yuan’s inner world was far more than thirty, at least ten times more.

“With the help of these resources, my ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ may not be able to cultivate to Level Eleven Perfect, but I can certainly make a significant leap towards perfection.”

Lin Yuan felt elated; the number of mighty weapons he now possessed probably surpassed the total number of mighty weapons ever crafted by the Human Civilization.

“It’s a pity… I didn’t get a single Clan Suppression Weapon…”

Lin Yuan sighed inwardly.

However, on second thought, he accepted it; even if a Clan Suppression Weapon were placed in front of him right now, Lin Yuan might not dare to take it.

A Clan Supression Weapon, due to its nature, is capable of sustaining the power of Twelve-Star ultimate beings, exceeding ordinary mighty weapons. If Lin Yuan were to carelessly incorporate a Clan Suppression Weapon into his inner world, he might very well be inviting the wolf into his house.

…

“Galaxy Master.”

At this moment, Xuanyuan You, leading a group of Human Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers, flew towards Lin Yuan.

“Hmm…” Lin Yuan glanced at Xuanyuan You, with most of his attention still on evaluating the spoils within his inner world.

There was no helping it; the harvest was too abundant, many of the treasures were beyond his immediate comprehension, and he could only ponder over them slowly.

“What now… What should we do now?”

Xuanyuan You asked the question on his mind. Logically speaking, as an Eleventh Level from the Human Civilization Alliance side, at this time, they should be fiercely battling the Eleventh Level entities of the other races.

But now.

All of the other races’ Eleventh Level entities were dealt with by Lin Yuan alone.

This resulted in the Eleventh Level powerhouses of the Human Civilization Alliance not knowing what to do.

“Wait for the response of the supreme beings.”

Lin Yuan spoke.

Everything that happened within the supermassive battlefield was surely under the watch of the Twelve-Star ultimate beings.

Now, they only need to see what the other peak cosmic race forces will think.

Should I concede defeat and cede the first battlefield dominance, or attempt to commit more Eleventh Level Perfected Evolvers?

“Alright.”

Xuanyuan You nodded.

He should have thought of this sooner; only the actions of the Galaxy Master left his mind in disarray, slowing his thought processes considerably, his heart unable to calm for a long time.

…

Beyond the super-large battlefield.

The ultimate beings of the Twelve-Star level also fell into silence.

When Lin Yuan first arrived at the battlefield, his stomp almost wiped out the Insect Race Alliance.

The Twelve-Star ultimate beings then sensed something was amiss.

However, none of the Twelve-Star ultimate beings anticipated such an outcome; within a mere six seconds, only the Human Civilization Alliance remained out of the twelve peak tribal powers.

During that time, some Twelve-Star ultimate beings wanted to intervene… but the super-large battlefield was forged jointly by numerous ultimate beings, and partial authority was held by the supreme beings of human civilization.

Without the consent of the human civilization’s supreme beings, other Twelve-Star ultimate beings found it difficult to break through the restrictions of the super-large battlefield in a short time.

Of course, this didn’t only apply to the alien Twelve-Star ultimate beings.

If the human civilization’s supreme beings desired to interfere with matters within the battlefield, and the Twelve-Star ultimate beings of other peak tribal powers didn’t agree, it would also be very difficult to influence the battlefield in a short amount of time.

This was mutual.

“Xuanyuan Supreme, your Galaxy Master from the Human Civilization, very good, very good indeed.”

“Was the final method employed by the Galaxy Master sourced from your Human Civilization’s ultimate reserve? To gain dominance of the battlefield for the first time, did your Human Civilization actually resort to using your ultimate reserve?”

“We’re done for, this time all eleven peak tribal powers have fallen into the hands of human civilization…”

…

One by one, the Twelve-Star ultimate beings turned their gazes toward the nine supreme beings of human civilization, their tones displeased and expressions cold.

Although the Eleventh Level powerhouses who fell on the battlefield were mostly clones, many of the supreme weapons ended up in the hands of the Galaxy Master.

These supreme weapons, the accumulation of unknown years of effort by various peak tribal powers, now all benefitted the Galaxy Master.

Had it not been for the restraints of the super-large battlefield, during those six seconds, there really would have been Twelve-Star ultimate beings unable to resist intervening.

At least several Queens of the Insect Race and progenitors of the Tianyu Clan would have likely lost control, especially the Insect Race; their hives are already scarce, and the so-called ‘Sea of Bugs’ tactic refers to the countless Insect Race Warriors spawned by the hives.

As for the hives themselves, they are extremely rare.

“Hahahaha.”

A smile spread across Xuanyuan Supreme’s face, utterly ignoring the dissatisfaction of the many Twelve-Star ultimate beings.

What defines a peak tribal power? It is to stand at the pinnacle of the universe, with virtually no possibility of falling.

Even if the Human Civilization were to go to war with the other eleven peak tribal powers at once, it would not be destroyed, and the eleven peak tribal powers would not dare to press human civilization too hard.

Therefore—

The performance of Lin Yuan on the battlefield, even if it caused unanimous dissatisfaction among the other eleven peak tribal powers, was of no concern to the nine supreme beings of human civilization.

The rules of the super-large-scale war had long been set.

If your tribal Eleventh Level were slaughtered, it’s because you were too weak.

Supreme Xia Qin also maintained a smile nearby.

At the same time, Xuanyuan Supreme’s voice sounded in his ear.

“Xia Qin, was that final method employed by the Galaxy Master one of human civilization’s ultimate reserves?” Xuanyuan Supreme’s tone was puzzled.

Xuanyuan Supreme knew almost all about human civilization’s ultimate reserves, and there was no such method as Lin Yuan had employed.

But aside from the ultimate reserves, what else could explain the scene of the crushing of tens of thousands of Eleventh Level aliens?

“I am not sure either.”

Supreme Xia Qin immediately replied telepathically.

In fact, he was quite puzzled…

He really knew nothing.

Supreme Xia Qin had indeed thought of endowing Lin Yuan with certain fallbacks.

But these had no significant relation to the ultimate reserves of human civilization.

“You’re not sure either…” Xuanyuan Supreme fell silent; could it be that the Galaxy Master’s final method of crushing tens of thousands of Eleventh Level aliens was achieved on his own?
